name: Unframed
summary: A film project created by four actors who each wrote and directed an episode for themselves.

name: Ghost Signal
summary: Hard-working barista Ha Ri started working at Redsome Cafe to buy a gift for her boyfriend, the girl not only prepares delicious coffee, but also manages to observe the relationship of her guests. Soon, a mysterious stranger appears in the cafe, warning Ha Ri about the danger, after all, a young girl has recently disappeared. But the missing girl often appears at the cafe, only in the guise of a ghost.

name: Пара на миллион
summary: The show will meet two different worlds: active, self-confident and liberated single girls who know everything about the world of Instagram, fashion and events, and their complete opposite - restrained single guys who devote all their time to work, watching science videos on YouTube and reading books. Already in the first issue, the participants will unite in 12 pairs. And in this line-up, all subsequent tests will be held in order to earn one million hryvnias!

name: Mükemmel Eşleşme
summary: Everyone knows the phrase - marriages are made in heaven. But sometimes the parents of the bride and groom try very hard in this. The parents of the main characters constantly said that it was time for them to start their own family and got a little fed up with such requests. Only a good partner is very difficult to find, and even more so if there is no such desire. The girl and the guy were quite satisfied with their lives and did not even plan to tie the knot in the near future. But they understand that they are no longer able to withstand the instructions from their relatives and will have to change something in their lives.

name: The Perfect Couple
summary: Amelia Sacks is about to marry into one of the wealthiest families on Nantucket. Her disapproving future mother-in-law, famous novelist Greer Garrison Winbury, has spared no expense in planning what promises to be the premiere wedding of the season - until a body turns up on the beach. As secrets come to light, the stage is set for a real-life investigation that feels plucked from the pages of one of Greer's novels. Suddenly, everyone is a suspect.

name: Drive Hard: The Maloof Way
summary: The Maloofs, a lovable family of gearheads and stunt drivers, use their passion and skill to build car engines and perform wild feats behind the wheel.

name: Outchef'd
summary: Confident home cooks think they are arriving for an audition - but get the surprise of their lives when they find out they are actually heading into a head-to-head competition against a world-class chef. These home cooks excel in their own kitchen - but do they have what it takes to succeed against an elite pro under the lights and cameras of a culinary battle? After a star-ingredient themed cooking round, the fun continues as Eddie hits the streets to find a panel of six regular folks to blindly taste the dishes. To even the playing field, the home chef has to receive only one vote to win a $5,000 prize. Star chefs competing against the home cooks are Eric Adjepong, Anne Burrell, Maneet Chauhan, Scott Conant, Tiffani Faison, Amanda Freitag, Alex Guarnaschelli, Antonia Lofaso, Marc Murphy and Geoffrey Zakarian.

name: Capturing Home
summary: Designers Amy and Kate take inspiration from homeowners' personal stories to create custom, one-of-a-kind spaces for their families to gather.

name: Recipe Lost and Found
summary: Classically trained chef and food anthropologist Casey Corn is on a journey to help people rediscover their lost family recipes, diving into each family's history and culture to reveal the magic behind the dish.

name: Модные игры
summary: Every week, interior designers, hypnologists, SMM managers, astrologers and even policemen will become guests of the program. Their task is to create a trendy look that will make the jury believe that they are professional stylists. A team of judges, consisting of designers and fashion bloggers, will have to determine which of the participants are pros and who are amateurs. But the main goal of the show is not to reveal the deceivers, but to prove that anyone can actually be a stylist.

name: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
summary: Master filmmakers and genre experts celebrate and dissect the most terrifying moments of the greatest horror films ever made, exploring how these scenes were created and why they burned themselves into the brains of audiences around the world.

name: Dimension 20's Adventuring Party
summary: A Dimension 20 talkback show where GM and players discuss the events of the latest episode.

name: Tod und Spiele - München 72'
summary:
Munich, 1972: The Olympic Games should show Germany as a young, cosmopolitan democracy.

They are overshadowed by the bloody attack on the Israeli team. 50 years later, the four-part documentary series " Death and Games - Munich `72 " tells the story of an attack that shook the world with the voices of those involved and using newly accessible sources.

name: The Group Chat
summary: Join the Virgin Media News team, Gavan Reilly, Zara King and Richard Chambers, as they discuss the latest and breaking news.

name: Second Hand for 50 Grand
summary: Behind the scenes of a company that tracks down luxury second-hand items, hunting down the exact handbags, watches and jewellery on their clients' wish-lists.

name: The Great Smog: Winter of '52
summary: Dr Xand Van Tulleken and Raksha Dave investigate the Great Smog of 1952 - the deadliest environmental disaster ever recorded and one of the world's worst peacetime catastrophes. Lasting just over four days, the Great Smog plunged London into a terrifyingly murky gloom - the acrid pollution seeping into homes, leaving Londoners gasping for breath, shutting down transport and emergency services, and overwhelming hospitals and undertakers alike.

name: Billionaire Holiday Resort
summary: Series going behind the scenes at the world's most luxurious holiday destinations, revealing the dedication and expertise it takes to deliver a first-class service.

name: Gino's Italy: Like Mamma Used to Make
summary:
Gino D'Acampo is returning to his motherland to learn more from the Mammas of Italy.

In this personal food odyssey, Gino will be travelling the length and breadth of Italy from Naples, Florence and Bologna to encounter local dishes from families and their matriarchs along the way.

name: Work From Heart
summary: Dee is a spoiled rich boy. His parents passed away when he was a little kid. So Dee is the one whose grandma and grandfather expect to be the next one who runs the family business. And It's time for Dee to do an internship to graduate the university. But his grandfather thinks that Dee can't do anything on his own so his grandpa secretly plans to take over DIFA company where there is an agency that Dee is heading for. Dee has to work with Knight a heartless Senior Marketing employee and the problem is Dee's face accidentally looks alike his bride who's broken his heart.

name: Tyler Perry's Zatima
summary: Zac and Fatima take a huge step to strengthen their bond, but new friends and past actions interfere with their blossoming relationship.

name: Halloween Cookie Challenge
summary: This Halloween, candy is not the only sweet treat we'll be enjoying. Expert chef Jet Tila and baking queen Rosanna Pansino bring together four of the best cookie makers in the country to compete in two rounds of baking, decorating and 3D cookie making to prove they are the cookier to fear! The winner will take home a trick-or-treat bag filled with $10,000 and the title of Halloween Cookie Champion.

previousepisode.name: Halloween Slice and Bake and 3D Haunted Mirror

name: Eli Roth Presents: My Possessed Pet
summary: Few things are more profound than the quiet bond between a person and their pet. But what if an evil presence takes hold of the animal and uses the trusted companion to get to us? Eli Roth Presents: My Possessed Pet explores the true, terrifying tales of what happens when evil spirits, curses and demons take over family pets and turn them against their terrified owners. Each episode will follow the chilling and deeply personal story of someone who has had their profound and loving relationship ripped apart by supernatural forces beyond their control.

name: Urban Legend
summary: This nightmarish anthology series, under the creative guidance of master of horror Eli Roth, showcases classic urban legends as you've never seen them before. Based on widely shared "true" stories that happened to a friend of a friend... of a friend, each episode of Urban Legend is a mini-horror film cinematically crafted to deliver a hyper-suspenseful and tension-fueled experience. Featuring lurking psychopaths, murderous mysteries, creepy creatures and twisting tales, these disturbing legends prey on our most deeply embedded fears to shock and terrify.

name: SpaceVets
summary: SpaceVets was a 39-episode children's sci fi show about a motley crew of misfit intergalactic space vets. The concept was devised by Stephen Edmondson and Jerome Vincent, but the characters were created by writer Christopher Middleton, and most of the 39 episodes written by him, too. Music for the series was produced by former Doctor Who composer Dominic Glynn.

name: El Rey, Vicente Fernández
summary: From his humble upbringing to stardom, Mexican music icon Vicente Fernández's whirlwind of a life and career is recounted over seven decades.

name: Romantic Killer
summary: Anzu Hoshino is a "non-heroine type" high school girl who pays no attention to fashion or romance and spends every day playing video games. When the wizard Riri suddenly appears, Anzu is forced to participate in the Magical World's project to stop population decline. This romantic comedy depicts what happens when Anzu goes from living a life immersed in her three favorite things — video games, chocolate, and cats — to being surrounded by handsome guys. Anzu is steadfast in her claim that she never wanted to live in a dating simulation game. She meets a handsome guy who is so popular it hurts, a clean-cut and athletic childhood friend, and a beautiful rich young guy who is naive about the outside world. By meeting Anzu, they all begin to change gradually.

name: Gymnastics Academy: A Second Chance
summary: Kyra Berry, a 14 year old USA gymnast arrives in Australia to try and win a scholarship at an elite Gymnastics Academy. It's a second chance but also her last.

name: Once Again
summary: Shin Jae Woo is haunted by painful memories, yearning to change his destiny and that of Kang Ji Hoon. In 2007, their paths crossed, and Shin Jae Woo fell for Kang Ji Hoon deeply. However, fate tore them apart, and he's carried the guilt ever since. Fifteen years later, he finds himself in the dormitory where Kang Ji Hoon lived. Holding an intercom receiver, he hears Kang Ji Hoon's voice, realizing he's traveled back to 2007. Moving into the next room, he tries to rekindle their friendship, despite Kang Ji Hoon's confusion about this stranger who keeps calling him "uncle."

previousepisode.name: Please Come Back to Me Again

name: Police, Camera, Murder
summary: Unprecedented access reveals the critical role of digital forensics in modern murder investigations.

name: The NFL Show
summary: Laura Woods is joined by Jason Bell and Osi Umenyiora to present highlights.

name: My Alcohol Diary
summary: Lee Young Ji invites idols and personalities to her home to drink alcohol, talk about anything and everything in a warm and friendly atmosphere without preparing anything.

name: 50/50 Heroes
summary:
Half-brother, half-sister, half-superheroes!

There isn't a single person on Earth who hasn't dreamed of having superpowers, Mo and Sam (half-brother and sister, aged 11 and 9) are no exception! Until, one day, these siblings find out that their great-great-great-grandma once had a fling with a superhero (though it's not very clear who the lucky guy was).

They had a kid together, creating a potential hereditary "superhero streak" in Mo and Sam's family! Up until now, (almost) everyone in the family thought it was all just one big joke...

name: Фандорин. Азазель
summary: The October Revolution hadn't happened, and the Bolsheviks had never risen to power. The year is 2023, and the rule over the Russian Empire is divided between tzar Nikolai III and a forward-thinking PM, Dmitry Orlov. Erast Fandorin, a 20-year-old police servant, has just been hired in the criminal investigations unit at the Petrograd Metro. His job is not that exciting, but the latest news is: right at the heart of the capital, a young and wealthy oil company tycoon has just shot himself in front of dozens of men. His suicide was captured on the patrol robot cameras. Fandorin can't help but suspect that this case is far more complicated than it looks and takes on his very first major investigation.

name: Les Lascars
summary: Aged between fifteen and twenty-five, the lads live in urban areas. They occupy their time in different places (street, metro, stairs, apartment, shopping center, nightclub, etc.) and in different ways: flirting, parties, fights, discussions, break dancing, etc.

name: Magischer Maghreb
summary: The Maghreb countries of Tunisia, Algeria and Morocco are united by great geographic and cultural diversity. From the salt lake Chott El Djerid in southern Tunisia to the enchanted mountains and deserts of Algeria to the surfer's paradise of Imsouane on Morocco's Atlantic coast, the series shows impressive landscapes, but also life in the countryside and in the cities.

name: A Thousand Blows
summary: Hezekiah and Alec, two friends from Jamaica, find themselves thrust into the criminal underbelly of Victorian London's East End. Here they meet Mary Carr, Queen of an all-female criminal gang known as the Forty Elephants, and run afoul of Sugar Goodson, criminal kingpin and notorious boxer.

name: Emergency: First Time Medics
summary: Based at The Royal Berkshire Hospital in Reading, Emergency: First Time Medics will focus on newly qualified doctors, known as Senior House Officers (SHOs), as they are thrown into the deep end at the start of their year-long placement on the NHS frontline.

name: Painting Birds with Jim and Nancy Moir
summary: Painting Birds with Jim and Nancy Moir will follow prolific artist Jim and his wife Nancy as they explore some of Britain's best beauty spots, joined along the way by a few famous friends. Their challenge? Create an original piece of bird art celebrating the unique species native to that region over the course of a weekend.

name: Munich Games
summary:
50 years after the terrorist attack on the Olympic Games, a friendly soccer match between an Israeli and a German football club is planned, as a memorial service for the victims of the 1972 event. Police and secret services are on high alert to ensure the security of the event. 

When Oren Simon, a Mossad agent stationed in Berlin, intercepts a message in a dark web forum, just days before the game, he is partnered with Maria Köhler, a German State Criminal Police officer (LKA),  with Lebanese roots. All sides must come together to ensure that history does not repeat itself.

name: Kingdom of Dreams
summary: Kingdom of Dreams will be a visually dazzling chronicle of the fashion world spanning three decades - from the early-1990s to the 2010s. It is a Golden Age, a time when the forces of ground-breaking creativity and disruptive business converge and collide. Fashion explodes out of the traditional, elite kingdoms of haute couture and style - Paris, Milan, London and New York - to become a truly global phenomenon.

name: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
summary: The Slow Mo Guys (Gav and Dan) set out to uncover mysteries from the past and recreate some of history's most explosive moments. With each episode taking on a daringly different theme, kids will experience bold adventures with Vikings, space rockets, the Wild West, and a whole lot more.

name: MC Grammar: Wonder Raps
summary: Rapper MC Grammar goes to the magical library in a bid to compose the best rap ever! Join him as he takes his imagination to another dimension and get your whole family to sing along to his catchy beats.

name: Spector
summary:
In the early hours of February 3rd, 2003, a 911 call was placed to the Alhambra, California Police Department reporting the fatal shooting of a woman. The location, an eccentric French chateau style mansion known as The Pyrenees Castle, was the home of legendary music producer Phil Spector. The woman was Lana Clarkson, a charismatic and once prolific film actress who he had met just that night.

How did the destinies of these two people become intertwined? And what actually happened on that fateful night?

name: The Good Fight Club
summary: The Good Fight Club follows the fortunes of a group of young Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) athletes fighting to make it from their South London gym to the glittering home of MMA: Las Vegas.

name: Whale with Steve Backshall
summary: Whale with Steve Backshall follows Steve as he embarks on a voyage of discovery into the most iconic, yet threatened, whales and dolphins across the Atlantic, Pacific and Indian Oceans. Together with world-leading scientists and conservationists, Steve will reveal what can be done to ensure their survival.

name: Fred West: The Glasgow Girls
summary: Fred West: The Glasgow Girls will unpick Fred West's three earliest known murders. With criminal tendencies dating back to his little-known years spent living in Glasgow, this series asks why these shocking signs were ignored, and how this period shaped the serial killer Fred West would become.

name: Innocent Lies
summary: Gun is Parin's best friend who owned a luxury hotel. They become business partners after Gun offers to sell some of his hotel's shares to Parin. Gun is also married, however, his marriage is rocky and he and his wife are going through a divorce. What's difficult is that his wife is determined to get her hands on the "Twilight Resort" through their divorce settlement. However, Gun has some incriminating evidence against her which can cost her this case. When his wife finds out about the evidence, she decides to offer Wimala a job to steal that evidence from Gun. Wimala refuses to do such a low deed at first, however, Gun's wife convinces her after showing Wimala the bruises and marks she has on her body from Gun's bondage play and abuse. Seeing the bruise and since she also needs money for her mother's treatment, Wimala agrees to this job — completely convinced that Gun is an abusive and evil person.

name: Sing Again
summary: Twins Sol and Sun are almost as different as night from day, but one thing they have in common is their mutual love for Piano, a girl who moved into the neighborhood when they were all kids and who they've been besties with ever since. They also share a dream of making it big in the music industry and together they barely manage to get into the Plus Artist Academy contest that's on the hunt for new Thai talent. A twist of fate, however, smashes their dreams, and turns Sun and Piano against Sol who got hired to be a member of a new Thai boy band by the Empire agency. But all isn't as it seems. Can the friends reconcile or is it too late to forgive when so much hurt has happened?

name: The Eight
summary: A gang plans to kill one of its members after disobeying the rules, but their plan goes south, leaving him alive to plot his revenge.

name: Màkari
summary: Saverio Lamanna has lost his job. He leaves Rome to take refuge in Màkari, a Sicilian village where a new life begins for him, seasoned with a historical friendship, a new love, and many mysteries.

name: Wild Switzerland
summary: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - This is Switzerland!

name: Orbital
summary: Orbital is a thriller event series set on the International Space Station

name: Horizon Zero Dawn
summary: Horizon Zero Dawn, based on the PlayStation video game, is set a thousand years in the future, in a strange and beautiful world full of primitive tribes and high-tech machines, all built on the bones of the ‘Old Ones' – the ruins of our present-day United States. The disaster that destroyed our world is long forgotten, but when these formerly peaceful machines mysteriously turn into dangerous hunters of all life, a young outcast named Aloy discovers that the only chance to save her world is to fight to uncover what happened to ours.

name: Rétroscopie
summary: Hélène Mannarino hosts a program that takes place in the future, in 2050, where she gives intimate interviews.

name: Deadly Women: Fatal Instincts
summary: Crime experts explore the motives and modus operandi of female killers. While males are often driven by anger, impulse and destruction, women usually have more complex, long-term reasons to kill.

name: Bir Küçük Gün Işığı
summary: The series is about the story of Elif, who has to start all over again after coming out of the dark to the light of day. Elif's life, who has been living in a lie for 10 years, turns upside down with the news she receives. Everything becomes more complicated when the path of the helpless young woman unexpectedly crosses with the wealthy businessman Fırat.

name: The Rebel
summary: "Rebel" is the narrator of a tumultuous drama about the journey of a hero who is accompanied or obstructed by various characters from different social classes. The rebel must cross the line between pain and fatigue.

name: Лучшие
summary:
Возвращение тех самых комиков. Возвращение тех самых номеров. И возвращение того самого юмора.

 

Переформатированное шоу "Игра" с новым названием, первые выпуски - нарезка из уже вышедшего, осенью обещают новое.

name: Mary Kay Letourneau: Notes on a Scandal
summary: With all the ingredients of a Hollywood movie, this sex scandal shocked, enthralled, and enraged 1990s America. 34-year-old elementary school teacher, Mary Kay Letourneau, who was married with 4 kids, began an affair in 1997 with her 12-year-old student, Vili Fualauu. They not only didn't deny the outrageous behavior, but they would also eventually embrace the love affair that included French-kissing on school grounds, trysts in her van, and even sexual rendezvous in her family home. The question on everyone's mind was: Is this true love, or is Mary Kay Letourneau a pedophile, guilty of child rape?

name: Superhero Tri
summary: Clare Balding presents highlights of Great Britain's only mass participation triathlon for disabled participants, held at Dorney Lake in Windsor.

name: Blue Planet III
summary: Blue Planet III will build on its groundbreaking legacy, redefining the realm of possibility in underwater wildlife film-making. Taking the wonder, immersion, and discovery of the Blue Planet brand to extraordinary new depths, it will reveal brand new and untold stories from magical underwater worlds. Combining our deeper understanding of the oceans with a whole new generation of camera technology, we can now showcase stunning stories and extraordinary behaviours, previously impossible to film or only recently discovered.

name: Mini Matchmakers
summary: In Mini Matchmakers we enter into the world of The Mini Matchmakers, a dating agency run by nine-year-olds. In each episode the mini matchmakers meet and interview singletons looking for love and then match up couples for that all-important first date. The cute cupids then select two dates for the singleton and watch as the love-matches go on a fun date.

name: Irish Dance Fever
summary: Irish Dance Fever takes viewers into the pressure-filled world of competitive Irish dancing. Following dancers from Northern Ireland and America, from two of the most successful dance schools, as they train and compete at the biggest competition of their year, the Irish Dancing World Championships.

name: B&B by the Sea
summary: B&B by the Sea is set in a Victorian guesthouse at Downhill Beach on the picturesque Antrim coast. The tranquil setting is a place of calm and it's a chance for celebrity guests to explore their connections to the sea and coast - but it is not all rest and relaxation, as Sharon and Rory from the B&B team put them through their paces. Our celebrities also slip on their aprons to help Great British Menu chef Alex Greene prepare a gourmet meal using the best of local produce that audiences will be keen to try at home.

name: Nurses
summary: Nurses gets unprecedented access to some of our nurses in a variety of health settings, hearing their personal stories while providing an insight into the job they love. Filmed over 12 months, the series follows the team of nurses as they look after patients across a range of areas in the health service.

name: Barra's Return of the Wild
summary: Barra Best reveals how endangered animals across UK and Europe could be making a return.

name: Married at First Sight UK: Unveiled
summary: Companion show in which AJ Odudu rounds up all the drama and gossip from this year's Married at First Sight UK.

previousepisode.name: Judi Love, Paul C Brunson, Charlene Douglas

name: Dirty House Rescue: Queens of Clean
summary: Following a surprising and outrageous gang of cleaning enthusiasts, who come together to rescue homes stuck in a whirlwind of domestic despair.

name: Stupid Wife
summary: Luiza sees in Valentina all the flaws she believes someone can have, and hates her. One day, however, Luiza wakes up to find herself ten years older and, to her horror, married to Valentina.

name: Wonderful Fate
summary:
Adapted from the short story "The Governor of Nanke" (南柯太守传) by Li Gong Zuo (李公佐).

19-year-old Li Fu Zhu, who loves reading comic books and has a poor academic performance, accidentally enters the Yunlai Kingdom, a fictional place in the comic she is reading. In Yunlai, she is thought to be the heavenly fairy that falls from the sky by mistake. Therefore, she is regarded as the hope to save Yunlai and is treated on an equal basis with the young Emperor Yun Yi. With her little knowledge, Li Fu Zhu tries to help make the country rich and powerful but is involved in the power struggle between the corrupt officials. Upon meeting the cold Emperor Yun Yi, a fantastic journey of shared laughs and love begins.

name: Мистер Х
summary: 30 girls came to the project to compete for the heart of a crypto millionaire. But he has a secret: he is an ordinary guy, not a rich bachelor. Girls learn about it only at the end of the project. Which one of them will stay with Mr. X and choose love over money?

name: Wang Pai Xiao Cao
summary: Tang Mo Mo, who aims to become a fashion designer, is unexpectedly colorblind. However, Ling Yao was born in a wealthy family, but he could not find the direction in life despite of his efforts. What kind of sparks will ensue when this lost boy with outstanding talent from a famous family collide with a vigorous girl who is brave and never gives up

name: Wo De Fan Pai Fu Jun
summary: Bai Xiao Tang finds herself in the world of a novel, where she has transformed into the wife of a villain. She asks that her husband divorce her, just when he is down and out. Deciding to avoid a predictable end, where she dies tragically at the hands of the villain, she hugs his thigh.

name: Четыре дачи
summary: Four avid summer residents will meet to find out who is better. The heroes will visit each other's dachas and evaluate them according to different parameters: home, garden and hospitality. The owner of the best dacha will take the cash prize and receive national recognition.

name: The Meaning of Life with Joe Duffy
summary: Joe Duffy interviews public figures about life, faith and spirituality.

name: World's Greatest Inventions
summary: The ways in which inventions have helped to change lives.

name: Love Me Actually
summary: Up until now, there has not been a club like this one. The Love Me Actually club is a unique gathering of five, charming, single men, still in their quest of finding that genuine love. The five men meet other single women that join the club voluntarily to escape their dull and jaded lives. The club takes them to different destinations all over the country and gives them a chance to get to know each other. And who knows, maybe exploring new places might unknowingly spark that love they all desire. The five eligible bachelors consist of the comic Heo Kyeong Hwan, the business savvy entrepreneur Park Sung Kwang, the rapper from INFINITE Dong Woo, the irresistible smiley Yang Se Chan, and the youngest of them all, the up-and-coming star actor Kim Min Gue. Join them and the hosts in this real romance variety show and experience the endless laughter, the awkwardness, and the affection each one of them has to offer. Maybe you should volunteer to join. Who will be the one to make your heart flutter?

name: Sihame
summary: Sihame is out for revenge after a sex video of her goes viral. With brute violence she opens the hunt for the guys who did this to her.

name: Tamil Rockerz
summary: Anonymous cyber pirates are threatening to release a highly anticipated film featuring a massively popular star. It's up to the cop Rudra to find the lawbreakers and bring them to justice.

previousepisode.name: Voor Ine is FIRE een mindset, geen middel tot geluk

name: Rob Rinder's Interrogation Secrets
summary:
Rob Rinder's Interrogation Secrets takes a unique look at the battle of wits between police and suspects in some of the most disturbing US and UK criminal cases of recent years. Criminal barrister and television personality, Robert Rinder, and a team of experts analyse police interviews. In each of these, the skilled work of detectives was key to cracking the case and securing a conviction.

With Rob as the expert guide, retired senior detectives from the U.S. and the UK, forensic and criminal psychologists, and body language experts examine the original police footage of interrogations at the heart of each case, to reveal the 'tricks of the trade' used to extract a confession and the tell-tale signs that a suspect is lying.

name: Sit Al Hosn
summary: To keep her alternative business running, a middle-aged businesswoman resorts to an unusual solution that coincides with a series of mysterious disappearances in her hometown.

name: The Deadly Affair
summary: An engineer, who served time in prison for a car accident, tries to make amends with the woman whose fiancé was killed. But she swears to take revenge.

name: Alice, the Final Weapon
summary:
Gyeo Wool  might look like just another normal high school student but in reality, she harbors a dark secret: she's actually a trained killer. Posing as a transfer student to hide her true identity, Gyeo Wool does her best to blend in, but it's not easy. Especially not after she meets Yeo Reum.

Unlike his classmates, Yeo Reum spends most of his life feeling nothing at all. Having experienced extreme trauma in the past, Yeo Reum is only able to feel alive when he's in pain. Accepting pain as his only connection to a "normal" life, Yeo Reum has no problem getting involved in Gyeo Wool's life, especially not once he realizes there's something very different about her.

Though neither expected to be involved in each other's lives, Gyeo Wool and Yeo Reum have no choice but to stay together after a criminal organization begins to hunt them down. Will this unlikely duo prove victorious in an increasingly deadly game of cat and mouse?

An intense thrill-ride from start to finish, "Alice, the Final Weapon" is a 2022 South Korean action romance drama directed by Lee Byung Hun.

name: Junai Dissonance
summary: The story takes place in a certain high school. Masaki Nitta arrives as a new music teacher, but the school is greatly disturbed by the disappearance of the previous teacher. While playing the piano in the music room the night before work, Masaki meets Sae Izumi, a student who is running away from one issue. Sae is a student in the class in which he is an assistant teacher. The two of them, gradually develop a bond through the disappearance.

name: Кіборги
summary:
September 2014, Donetsk airport. For the fourth month, the Ukrainian military repels opponents' attacks, who are seeking to get one of the key points for the troops' basing and transferring. A group of young soldiers gathered from volunteers comes here for a two-week duty. They study, participate in battles, and communicate with each other and with a local psychologist in an attempt to formulate their attitude towards the conflict and people.
The military drama Cyborg is an emblematic Ukrainian movie, which deals with the events that really took place in Donbas. The four-episode serial version contains 60% of new material that was not included in the theatrical version.

name: One Night Morning
summary:
Relationships take on many forms. Some can be fleeting, delicate things that only last a moment, while others are sure and steady and can last a lifetime. More often than not, relationships fall somewhere in between, but whatever the relationship, each one is as unique as the people in them.

Take the eight different couples in this story, for example. While each of them ends up sharing a night, how that night looks and what comes the morning after is entirely different. For the man reunited with his former high school classmate, the feelings he has harbored all these years give their time together a very specific meaning. Meanwhile, an evening shared by two individuals who regularly hook up for sex takes on an entirely different one. 

No matter what their dynamic may be, each couple in this series has this in common: they each share a meal the morning after. The question is, where do things go between them, once they've finished their breakfast? 

Adapted from the manga series of the same name by Kenichi Okuyama, "One Night Morning" is a 2022 Japanese romance drama directed by Kensaku Kakimoto.

(Source: Viki)

name: Sago Mini Friends
summary: This preschool animated series follows Harvey the floppy-eared dog and his best friends: Jinja the cat, Jack the rabbit, and Robin the bird. Along with a unique cast of residents as colorful as their own whimsical world, the four friends play, explore, imagine and celebrate daily in their joyful town of Sagoville. In each episode, Harvey and his friends express their true gratitude for all things, big and small, through optimism, kindness, preschool-friendly humor and unforgettable original songs.

previousepisode.name: Leaf It to Harvey and Jinja

name: Crash Course
summary: The series tells the story of eight students who have arrived for studies at Kota's two biggest, rival coaching institutes – the Ratanraj Jindal and Arvind Batra-led centres. These are the owners of the top institutes hell-bent on finishing the other to gain complete control of the education business in Kota. Their no-holds-barred rivalry is akin to a chess game. The pawns in this game, are the students and the teachers. Their student life is full of fun and camaraderie in the beginning but slowly the pressures and the competition intensifies. As the two drastically different worlds of the students and the coaching institute owners collide, there is pandemonium. The stakes are raised, motives clash and lives are put at risk.

name: B.R.I
summary: At the BRI Versailles, a historical unit specializing in organized crime, Saïd leads a team made up of young elite cops as reckless as they are efficient.

name: América vs. América
summary: This docuseries delves into the past, present and future of América, the most winning and controversial soccer club in Mexico. Starring club legends like Cuauhtémoc Blanco, Carlos Reinoso, Daniel Brailovsky, "Zague," Iván Zamorano and many more.

name: The Case I Can't Forget
summary: The programme that features first-hand accounts by detectives who worked on difficult cases, revealing not just the story of a crime, but the dedication and personal commitment necessary to solve one.

name: Dangerous Waters
summary: Follow the Dangerous Waters crew members as they embark upon an epic adventure riding their JetSki personal watercraft around the world. See all the excitement as these adventurers encounter foul weather, rough seas and the unknown. Watch as these men battle the elements on JetSkis!

name: Mon meilleur ami
summary: Simon and Alex are inseparable friends. While the two guys are practicing rock climbing, Alex's life changes: he hits his neck against a rock. Alex will emerge from his paraplegic accident. From now on, his wife Maryse watches over everything and must mourn her family and couple life. Consumed by guilt, Simon will offer time and comfort to Maryse, who is at her wit's end. When Alex sees that his life is slipping away from him, he will try to reverse the situation...

name: Icons Unearthed: The Simpsons
summary: Cast, crew, and experts will reveal never-before-heard stories about the most iconic film and television series.

name: Second World
summary: K-pop girl group main rappers' vocal battle! Their first step as vocalists beyond rappers! Who will be the artist who will be recognized in "The Second World"?

name: More Than Words
summary: Innocent days are filled with kindness, at times with bitterness, but are always brimming with light. Mieko and Makio are friends in high school who befriend Eiji, a college student who works with them. Eiji and Makio fall in love, Mieko gives birth to their child, and Makio encounters his old childhood friend Asato. This is a story of youth and their beautiful yet bitter experiences.

name: Nikki Bella Says I Do
summary: Bella and Chingvintsev continue their love story and prepare for the next chapter of their lives and the one everyone has been waiting for ... the moment Nikki walks down the aisle and says "I do." This major moment is not without challenges as the bride and groom navigate parenthood with their son Matteo, plan a wedding, bachelorette party, find a dress, tuxedo, choose the right venue all while they hold on to hope that Artem's family from Russia will make it to this event of a lifetime. With Nikki's sister, Brie, by her side and so much at stake, will Nikki and Artem's dream wedding come together without a hitch?

name: Nordisch Herb
summary: An unequal couple on the hunt for criminals: The old warhorse Jon Peterson gets reinforcements from Berlin: The attractive Nora Neubauer is supposed to stir up the Husum police force.

name: North Shore
summary: North Shore follows the clash of cultures when British and Australian detectives team to solve a complex murder mystery, and uncover a conspiracy with international political consequences.

name: BMC Way: Thai Rap Mission
summary: Thai-Japanese hip-hop group Baby Mic Candy travels from Fukuoka to Thailand where they'll learn about the culture and search for a new member among Thai rappers. They aim to find inspiration for Thai music and earn their place at Big Mountain Music Festival 2022.

name: Lay's On Cruise
summary: Gun, Tay, Dew, PP and Billkin go on a sea trip. For two days and one night, the five will live together and compete to win coins in order to unlock a final treasure.

name: The Power and the Glory
summary: Man's love affair with fast, beautiful cars is enduring. Few sports can match the vitality, the sheer extravagance and spectacle of a motor race. The Power and the Glory is a vivid account of the development of this exhilarating popular culture from the pioneer days in the 1880's and the birth of the sport in France in the early 1890's, through The Golden Age with the Bentley Boys and the Bugatti Set, right up to the commercialisation and the glittering prizes of the present with Fangio, Moss, Senna and Mansell along the way - a century of magnificent sport.

name: UnPrisoned
summary: Follows a therapist and single mom whose life is turned right-side-up when her dad gets out of prison and moves to her house to live with her and her teenage son.

name: Шоу Аватар
summary: Thanks to motion capture and virtual reality technologies, characters that do not exist in reality, but loved since childhood, will appear on the stage - from fairy tale heroes to fantastic aliens from other galaxies. From real participants, they will get a voice, movements and emotions, according to which the jury will have to guess who is hiding behind the avatar.

name: Begusarai
summary: Serious passions flare up in the godforsaken small village of Begusaray. Illegal reprisals, lynching are repaired by a wealthy family, which keeps all local residents at bay. However, the clan itself is torn apart from within by family squabbles, hatred, envy and harmful passions. The situation escalates to the limit when a charming dancer appears in the village.

name: Shisang Zui Qiang Nan Zhujiao
summary: Zhao Xiaotian is gifted with supernatural abilities and possesses super self-healing ability. After an accidental explosion, he came to a new world advocating martial arts and became the grandson of the richest man Zhao family. He was sent by his family to the famous martial arts sect, Xiaoyaomen, to practice martial arts for self-defense. However, to everyone's surprise, Zhao Xiaotian, who had never had a foundation in martial arts, was actually gifted with extraordinary talent, with an extraordinary talent for martial arts.

name: Andy vs. Wesley: Scoren in de kelderklasse
summary: Former top football players Andy van der Meijde and Wesley Sneijder train the worst teams in the Netherlands. They each take a team under their wing and prepare them for a final duel.

name: O Coro: Sucesso, Aqui Vou Eu
summary: A new musical company in Brazil is looking for young people who can sing and perform and they apply to the auditions from all over the country in search for success. This is a story of hardships and friendships on the road to fame.

name: Reborn Rich
summary: After ten years, a loyal employee is framed for embezzlement, then murdered by his employers, only to be reborn as their youngest son, with a yearn for revenge guiding his hostile takeover.

name: Joseon Attorney
summary: Joseon Attorney will revolve around Kang Han Soo, a skilled lawyer in the Joseon era who will defend and complete the law to take revenge on his parents' death. Because of this, he also became the hero of the nation as he becomes their spokesperson.

name: Bloodhounds
summary: Two young boxers band together with a benevolent moneylender to take down a ruthless loan shark who preys on the financially desperate.

name: Kompani Lauritzen: Tropp
summary: 12 young adults who are struggling to get their lives in order get help to cope with adult life through Dag Otto's special education.

nextepisode.name: Vi skal gjøre det, sammen - del 1

name: Boy Swallows Universe
summary: A young boy growing up in the suburbs of 1980s Brisbane faces the harsh realities of life — and the looming dangers that threaten his family.

name: Phony
summary: Phony is a coming-of-age mystery described as Freaks and Geeks trapped in The Twilight Zone. It follows Sonny, a popular high school kid who wakes up after a strange car accident and discovers his mom has been replaced by an impostor.

name: Side Story of Fox Volant
summary: Protagonist Hu Fei steps up to avenge his father's death and in doing so, goes from a brave but reckless teen to a hero among his generation that cares about the common people and serving communities all across the country.

name: New Year's Eve Live: Nashville's Big Bash
summary:
Originating from downtown Nashville across multiple locations, the star-studded special will be packed with high-energy performances celebrating the excitement and anticipation of a new year.

Music City has built an outstanding reputation for throwing the most musical New Year's celebration and country's biggest party. The five-hour celebration features nearly 50 performances from locations across the city, including the mainstage in Nashville's Bicentennial Capitol Mall State Park. The broadcast will cross multiple time zones, with the traditional countdown at midnight ET, culminating with the renowned Nashville Music Note Drop and fireworks at midnight CT.

previousepisode.name: New Year's Eve Live: Nashville's Big Bash (Part 2)

name: Rental Redo
summary: Designer Keyanna Bowen has a passion for renovating rental properties, showing you don't have to spend a lot of money to make a big impact. She reveals cost-saving tips while updating rentals to help tenants feel more at home.

name: Baked in Tradition
summary: Baker Bryan Ford explores the techniques and traditions behind New York City's best baked goods, and how the city's diverse cultures put their own twists on simple ingredients to bring family and friends together, every time.

name: Belascoarán, PI
summary: Place an old desk, sit, smoke and wait? Maybe not... A city like Mexico City needs its own detective. Soon, Belascoarán Shayne will take us to discover what it takes to be an independent detective in Mexico's 70s.

name: The Cage
summary: A marriage counselor tries to dissuade his warring clients from getting a divorce while juggling his own romantic dilemmas.

name: Sadece Arkadaşız
summary: The life of F. Ece and Umut, who decided to share the same house; He is upset by a surprise decision from Umut's aunt. The aunt, who has decided to dispose of all her possessions, will leave the only house she has left to whoever marries first. Although Umut and F. Ece do not look forward to marriage, they go on a date with a different person every day in order to become the owner of the house and start looking for the right spouse.

name: Aldatmak
summary: He is a distinguished, respected family court judge. She is an honest and principled woman who has saved many marriages from destruction, made sure that many children receive the affection and love they deserve, and has always been on the side of justice. She thinks that they are an exemplary family with her husband and two children, that they live an honorable life, and that the rest of their marriage will pass in usual love, happiness and peace. One day, Güzide accidentally pulls a noose and she starts to realize that her happy family is not a warm home, but a sand castle.

name: Shinobi no Ittoki
summary: In the eyes of the general public, ninjas do not exist. In reality, even if their existence would not be totally unfounded, they would never reveal themselves to normal people. It is for this reason that they are considered to be just a myth. Sakuraba Ittoki is an ordinary young man. He leads a normal, happy life, until the day he is the victim of an assassination attempt. Very quickly, he learns that if he has been targeted, it is because he is the descendant of a famous clan of ninjas, that an opposing clan is trying to make disappear. No choice for Ittoki, to have a chance of surviving against his attackers, he will have to learn to fight, in order to, too, become a full-fledged ninja!

name: The Queen's Umbrella
summary: A drama that deals with the top 1% education method of princes in the Joseon Dynasty and depicts the struggle of China to make troublemaking princes of the royal family into real princes.

name: Suppressed Science
summary: A series that mixes mind blowing real science with unsolved mysteries global conspiracies & true stories.

name: 3Hz
summary: Exciting series about Felix and his friends who can hear the past via a Walkman and thus end up in an exciting adventure.

name: The Eggs
summary: Welcome to the planet Kazoo where music is more than just a career, it's a way of life. Benedict, Sunnyside, Yolky and Scramble are our four eggy heroes whose mission it is to find new sounds. Join them on their fun-filled adventures in space - you'll have a smashing time. The Eggs is a Australian-Canadian animated series produced by Funbag Entertainment, VGI Entertainment, B&T Entertainment and animated by Atomic Productions for the Nine Network. It aired from 2004 to 2005, with the total of 52 episodes.

name: Just Jamie
summary: Just Jamie is an animated world of sleep-overs, phone tag and girl talk. Twelve-year-old Jamie's number-one priority is hanging out with her two life-long friends. It's her mixed-up place in the world that has Jamie always wondering, always searching. With her audience as her confidante, Jamie expresses her innermost "stuff," making her an expert guide to the muddled-up reality of being 12.

name: TAFKAL
summary: Ruben Nicolai, Tijl Beckand, Ruben van der Meer, Jeroen van Koningsbrugge and Patrick Lodiers: they are synonymous with improvisation and tax fraud, but they don't tour with the latter. As The Artists Formerly Known As Lamas (TAFKAL), they will be featured in an exclusive series after the summer.

name: Goodbye Earth
summary: As an asteroid hurtles towards Earth with nothing to stop it, one determined teacher fights to keep her former students safe -- no matter the cost.

name: One Hundred Won Butler
summary: The story of a male butler Kim, who runs errands that start with 100 won per day, and a funeral instructor Baek Dong-joo, who fulfills the wishes of the dead, running a daily errand company called One Hundred Won Butler.

name: America's National Parks
summary: National Geographic takes viewers on an extraordinary venture across world-famous and lesser-known national parks to reveal the diversity and wonder of this beautiful country, from the lush valley floors of Yosemite to the constantly erupting volcanoes of Hawai'i.

name: Neven's Portuguese Food Trails
summary: Neven Maguire goes on a culinary journey around Portugal.

name: Takeaway Titans
summary: James Kavanagh and Carl Mullan present the search for Ireland's best takeaway, with judges chef and critic Dylan McGrath and takeaway expert Suzie Lee Arbuthnot.

name: No Worries If Not!
summary: Fast-paced, viral sketch show with the biggest stars of Irish online comedy - Sean Burke, Michael Fry, Justine Stafford, Emma Doran and Killian Sundermann.

name: Cunk on Earth
summary: In this deeply profound and important mockumentary series from Charlie Brooker, Philomena Cunk tells the entire story of Human Civilisation from prehistoric times to the present day, covering all the main bits of History, Science, Culture and Religion.

name: Britain's Next Prime Minister
summary: Live News coverage of Britain's Next Prime Minister. Hosted by Alastair Stewart.

name: GB Newsday with Mark Longhurst and Gloria De Piero
summary: The latest news headlines with feisty views, debate and in-depth interviews live on Britain's news channel. Hosted by Mark Longhurst and Gloria De Piero.

name: GB News Live with Patrick Christys
summary: The latest news headlines with feisty views, debate and in-depth interviews live on Britain's news channel. Hosted by Patrick Christys.

name: Friday Morning with Esther and Philip
summary: Welcome the weekend with the husband and wife duo, both serving MPs, as they celebrate the country's triumphs in their Best of British feature, and look at the good news where you are.

name: Common Sense Crusade with Calvin Robinson
summary: Join Calvin and guests as they analyse current events from a faith perspective.

name: Sarah's Mountain Escape
summary: HGTV Canada designer, Sarah Richardson, heads west to take on her biggest challenge yet, purchasing a dated and drab 5,000-square-foot Bavarian-inspired B&B in Whistler, BC. Audiences will step inside Sarah's life with husband Alex and daughters Robin and Fiona as they travel across the country to transform the property into an efficient and profitable, four-season luxury vacation rental. It's a massive undertaking as Sarah juggles the demands of managing a "back to the studs" renovation on the west coast while running her design business in Toronto and raising two kids.

name: Girlfriend Project Day 1
summary: Hee Ram and Ga In met in a general education class, Psychology of Love and Sex class. In this class, students have to perform a dating mission as a mock couple. A hard-working student Hee Ram and an easy-goer Ga In don't quite get along with each other from their first meeting.

name: Joko Anwar's Nightmares and Daydreams
summary: Joko Anwar's Nightmares and Daydreams is a sci-fi thriller series about ordinary people encountering strange phenomena. The series has multiple storylines which intersect with each other and lead to a dramatic denouement.

name: Rybish
summary: He's one of the big names of the small screen, with a career that spans decades. There's no doubt that Dyfed Thomas is one of Wales's great actors. So why is his latest project Rybish (Rubbish)?

name: Fifteen-Love
summary: Former tennis prodigy Justine Pearce makes an allegation against her former coach Glenn Lapthorn 5 years after an injury puts a stop to her career.

name: Soy tu Fan
summary: Charly García and Nicolás meet in a cafe and from that moment he will follow her as a fan. She will feel flattered, but at the same time harassed. Charly's previous relationship hit her deeply, and in her eagerness to forget about her, it will be Nico who manages to get her out of that morass.

previousepisode.name: El Amor Está en el Aire

name: Stiletto
summary: When a corpse drops from the top floor during a grand party, officer Rami questions all witnesses to find the murderer but uncovers a past filled with betrayal.

name: Bring Back My Girls
summary: Host Ts Madison brings back the casts of your favorite RuPaul's Drag Race seasons in front of a live audience at DragCon LA. Queens from the US, UK, Canada, Holland, and Down Under reunite to spill the tea on their seasons and update fans on where they are now! There are laughs, fights, nostalgia, insider stories, tears, and even some never before heard confessions.

name: Sketchy Queens
summary: After meeting in their hometown of Portland, Oregon, Jinkx & Liam quickly found they shared a twisted sense of humor and started writing sketches together in quarantine. Sketchy Queens is born out of their weirdest ideas, featuring celebrity impersonations, a revival of Jinkx's first Snatch Game character Little Edie, and hilarious (and humiliating) new material from this duo's wacky minds.

previousepisode.name: I Really See You and I Truly Hear You

name: Muff Busters
summary:
They have charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent. But do these gals have the stuff to BUST these MUFFS? 
Join Heidi N Closet & Rock M Sakura as they dive in and put today's most popular myths (and each other) to the ultimate test. Each episode, Rock and Heidi take a widely accepted myth, read it the house down and spill the tea on what they believe are the facts before testing their hypotheses. They're busting open these myths to get to the truth, hunty! But will the science leave them gagging? 
Get ready boots for FACT and FICTION to collide on Muff Busters!

previousepisode.name: Your Hair and Nails Keep Growing Once You're Dead

name: Tongue Thai'd with Pangina Heals
summary: Pangina Heals, star of Drag Race Thailand and RuPaul's Drag Race UK vs the World takes us on a food tour of Thai Town in Hollywood, CA. She challenges her guests to amp up the spice, from one dish to the next, as they spill secrets over a meal of Thai delicacies. Don't get burned! Sweat it out with Pangina Heals.

name: Jimbo Presents: It's My Special Show!
summary: Join RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars 8 Winner Jimbo as she clowns around in her own special studio - interviewing esteemed guests, playing out-of-this-world games, and taking it to the streets of Hollywood. Grab a front row seat into the mind of the world's first self-proclaimed Drag Clown. It's My Special Show!

name: Squad Goals: Dorking ‘Til I Die
summary: Calum Best is the new chairman of Dorking Wanderers FC Ladies. The women are all juggling work and family life with their passion for football – while trying to win the league.

name: Intiqam Mashrou'
summary: Seven years after taking the fall for his brother Khaled, Youssef is released from prison, but soon finds out that his sibling may have wasted his sacrifice.

name: Love Beneath the Stars
summary: After that kiss in the field, Dominic and Luke are now entering a new stage in their relationship. But being in a same-sex relationship in an all-boys catholic school is never meant to be easy. The pressure from their friends, their parents, and the school prove to be insurmountable obstacles for a relationship destined by the stars. Despite all that life throws at them, Dominic and Luke try to be strong and keep their love going.

name: Don't Hug Me I'm Scared
summary: Part-educational programming, part-existential nightmare, Don't Hug Me I'm Scared is a mixed-media series that moves from kids-show pastiche to fever-dream horror in the blink of an eye. The hit youtube series garnered over 270 millon views and 2.63 million subscribers.

name: Lost Track of Time
summary: The moment she opened her eyes, ten years of bloody wind stirred Lu An Ran's heart. In this world, the peach blossoms are still there, but she is reborn with hatred and is no longer innocent. The unsuccessful person who stood on the bow of the ship and who has not yet become the devil, the young man who has been traveling the mountains and beloved all his life, when they once again stand at the fork in the road, how should Lu An Ran choose?

name: La Máquina
summary: After a devastating loss, Esteban "La Máquina" Osuna is at a low point in his boxing career. Lucky for him, his manager and best friend Andy Lujan is determined to get him back on top. But when a nefarious organization rears its head, the stakes of this rematch become life or death. While struggling to mount a comeback, Esteban must also juggle his own personal demons and protect his family, including his ex-wife Irasema, a journalist who finds herself on a collision course with the dark side of the boxing world.

name: Devil in Suburbia
summary: Tells the stories of ordinary folks who confront the evil that was always right in front of them. Through the lens of home archives, we journey with our insiders into shocking crimes to reveal what was missed before tragedy changed everything.

name: Paranoia
summary: A criminology research visit to prison changes Rawad's life when he meets Wazir, a schizophrenic who believes he's been framed for 21 murders.

name: Lost Man Found
summary: Adaptation from a novel about an actor struggling to find fame and the love of his life.

name: MasterChef Česko
summary: MasterChef Česko is a culinary reality show about amateur chefs who demonstrate their skills on the TV screen and fight each other for the MasterChef title and a prize of half a million crowns.

name: Brain, Your Choice of Romance
summary: A romantic fantasy drama about the first love of young people as the alter ego of their left and right brain are forcibly summoned into the real world.

name: Roast Battle Canada
summary: Each episode features two scorching standoffs between a pair of razor-sharp comics looking to be crowned battle victor by the distinguished panel of judges. Ready to prove they can deliver the superior jabs, the rules are simple – come prepared with original material, and contact should be of the verbal variety only.

previousepisode.name: Jon Dore vs. Rebecca Kohler, Kenny Robinson vs. Darren Frost

name: Stolen: Catching the Art Thieves
summary: The first-hand stories of Europe's most daring art heists, in which Turners, Rembrandts and Munch's The Scream are stolen.

name: The Irish League Show
summary: Watch highlights and analysis from all the weekend's Irish Premiership football action.

name: Little Big World
summary: Pond and Phuwin take on the big world by traveling to new places and trying new activities and food to broaden their horizons.

name: Epic Adventures with Bertie Gregory
summary: Part wildlife and part adventure show, follow the escapades of young National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory as he travels the world capturing extraordinary footage of wild animals. Using a combination of technical wizardry, secret fieldcraft and extreme perseverance, he and his team try to overcome the challenges and dangers and get as close as possible to wildlife on its own terms.

name: Volevo fare la rockstar
summary: Olivia is a 27-year-old girl in an existential crisis who found herself becoming a responsible adult quickly; raising her twins on her own and keeping a slacker brother out of trouble. An accident opens her eyes to the fact that there is only one life and that, perhaps, it is worth trying to change it in order to realize some of the dreams she had set aside.

name: INТуристы
summary: Travel-reality, which will open our country from a new exotic side. Presenters Maria Gorban and Alexey Krivenya will compile a guide to non-banal Russian attractions.

name: Bride of the Typhoon
summary: The story of a woman who became the daughter-in-law of an enemy for desperate revenge.

name: Wangu Shenhua
summary: A young boy from a small town whose spirit seed was destroyed, accidentally obtained the favor of the ancient treasure, a world where martial arts flourishes, a situation where crises abound, where should Wang Hao go in the center of the whirlpool?

name: Bad Prosecutor
summary: A story about prosecutor named Jin Jeong, armed with badness and worthlessness, breaking the sanctuary created by wealth and power. He chooses expediency over the law, trick over the standard, and defect over sincerity. He will provide a sense of exhilaration by punishing corrupt officials who are eating away at this society.

name: Curtain Call
summary: A work depicting the story of a man playing as a grandson to fulfill the last wish of an elderly grandmother who defected from the North.

name: Fearless: The Inside Story of the AFLW
summary: Fearless: The Inside Story of the AFLW embarks on a raw and emotional journey into the dreams, struggles and triumphs of the groundbreaking AFLW League.

name: Yonder
summary: A story that happens when a man who receives a message from his dead wife is invited to 'yonder,' an unknown space where he can meet her for the last time. Through various kinds of people facing the world, Yonder created by advances in science and technology, asks about life, death, and eternal happiness.

name: Ppalganpungseon
summary: The drama tells the story of the relative deprivation we all suffer, the thirst of our stomach aches, and our struggles to soothe our thirsts.

name: Against Darkness
summary: Sergeant Ko Fai completed undercover operations many years ago, and there is always a cloud hanging over him. Ko Fai is reassigned to a police precinct that is Crime Squad Station Sergeant Fong Chi-kiu's territory. While investigating cases, the duo gradually familiarize with each other and develop tacit understanding. Chi-kiu is so dedicated to her job that she has no time for taking care of her family. Her son hangs out with the wrong crowd and gets into trouble. Hotpot restaurant lady boss Lo Sin-man was naive when she was young as she slept with gang boss Law Wai and gave birth to a girl called Lo Siu-po. Fortunately, Ko Fai has always taken care of Sin-man and her daughter. Siu-po becomes a KOL and wants to step into the spotlight by engaging in reckless maneuvers. She gradually descends into the abyss as she reveals how drug dealers go about their business. To protect their loved ones, Ko Fai and Chi-kiu become guardians of the night and are determined to eradicate the villains!

name: İkinci Bahar
summary: The main character of the series is Ali Haidar. This is not a young man who has his own barbecue and earns a living from this. One day his wife goes missing. Her search was unsuccessful. Ali is left alone with three daughters. He starts thinking about the housekeeper...

name: Survivor
summary: 20 people, carefully selected from across the UK will be marooned in a tropical location. They will be divided into two tribes, going head-to-head in a range of physical and psychological challenges. Following a number of eliminations that will take place at the iconic tribal council, the tribes will eventually merge before one person takes away a cash prize and proves that they have what it takes to be the Ultimate Survivor.

name: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
summary: Five years ago, schoolgirl Andie Bell was murdered by Sal Singh. Case closed. The police know he did it. Everyone in town knows he did it. But Pippa Fitz-Amobi - our insatiably smart, slightly square heroine - isn't so sure and she's determined to prove it. But if Sal Singh isn't a murderer and the real killer is still out there, how far will they go to keep Pippa from the truth?

name: Гастротур
summary: Gastronomic journeys across Russia. Alexander Rembo Pushkov embarks on a tour of the country's cities in search of delicacies and culinary treasures. He will visit markets and restaurants, and visit local households to learn the distinctive cuisines of various Russian regions and the secrets of preparing iconic dishes.

name: Cosmic Cowboys
summary: A classic buddy show about two intergalactic bounty hunters: Curtis and Dook. Curtis is a superfly cat - goat mutant, he's a severe petrol-head and is always up for a party. Dook is very different, square, very big on rules and discipline. The main opponent of this more than dynamic duo is public enemy #1: Cereal Bob. Our space posse will travel from planet to solar system, no black hole is left unturned to find this evil bunny, but no matter how many times they deliver him at Deputy Roscoe's jail he always seems to have found a way to escape in the next episode. A combination of Western and sci-fi clichés make for a truly surprising universe, but, no matter where you find them, our bunny's the bane of those Cosmic Cowboys!

name: Угрозы
summary: Police Major Anastasia Latysheva investigates the murder of the owner of a beauty salon and gets acquainted with the "district" Ekaterina Aminova and a graduate of the law faculty of Moscow State University Lina Smirnova. They help her in this investigation, and after the appointment of Latysheva as the head of the women's "killer" department, Katya and Lina will become his new employees.

name: Папаши
summary: After 20 years in prison, Innokenty Bochkin is released on an unfair sentence. He is trying to reunite with his grown-up daughter Nastya, who was raised by police lieutenant colonel Vasily Tuchkov, who was forced to resign for refusing to participate in fraud. With the help of fun adventures, Bochkin manages not only to settle in Tuchkov's house, but also to have an affair with his sister Maria. Now Nastya and her two fathers are in for a lot of adventures, because by the will of circumstances Bochkin is forced, by order of the "authority", to steal the painting from the official, who, having learned about this, by all means available to him, tries to send him back to prison before he commits the theft.

name: The Legend of Kublai Khan
summary: The historical series tells about the life of the grandson of Genghis Khan - Kublai Khan. The plot spans several decades and tells about the events that led to the creation of the Yuan dynasty by the great Mongol. After the death of Genghis Khan, his sons Tului and Ogedei entered the struggle for power. Despite the fact that Ogedei becomes Khan, his wife Toregin does not leave anxiety, because she remembers how the Great Genghis Khan singled out among his grandchildren Khubilai, the son of Tului. And even after poisoning her husband's brother, Toregin tries to eliminate Möngke and Khubilai, who are thirsty for revenge for their father, accusing them of organizing an uprising. But thanks to the keen mind of Khubilai and the wisdom of his mother Sorgegtani, the Tului clan was saved.

name: Sometoon 2020
summary: It is the love triangle romance that takes place when YeJin went to search for her long-time online friend named "Sweet Brick". She does not know if he is the member of her craftwork class named No Woon or the man she often meets by chance named Cha Ieon. ~~Based on the webtoon of OH MY GIRL called "Sometoon x OH MY GIRL" but only partially as it is only Binnie's story which will make it on screen.

name: De Tafel van Gert
summary: Gert Verhulst receives four interesting guests every day and asks the questions that concern you.

name: Wanna
summary: Savvy saleswomen or devious scammers? Wanna Marchi and Stefania Nobile became the undisputed queens of Italian TV shopping — until they went too far.

name: Diario de un Gigoló
summary: A male escort's life begins to unravel when he gets involved in a client's family affairs and breaks the cardinal rule of his work: Don't fall in love.

name: Tehetség első látásra
summary: In this entertaining super production, the eye-catching visuals of show programs and the excitement of game shows are present at the same time. Amazing talents can show themselves, while a serious cash prize of HUF 10 million is at stake in the studio! Let's find out what they know!

name: El Galán
summary: Former soap opera heartthrob Fabián Delmar lives his life in near oblivion after his heyday in the 90s as the lead role in the series "Serás Mía." When Delmar — spurred on by a midlife crisis and the constant degradations of his twilight — sets out to make things right with the regrettable parts of his past, he struggles to find his footing in the modern world.

name: Interviews with Extra Dimensionals
summary:
Ever wonder if intelligent life existed elsewhere in the Universe? If higher intelligent beings from other worlds do exist? Are they here on Earth? If so, then why? Why don't they make themselves more public? Why the secrecy?

In this series Reuben Langdon interviews actual ETs or EDs (Extra Dimensionals) as they call themselves. Each episode focuses on one particular race or "Collective" of Beings and/or an actual being who channels through a particular person or persons. The goal for this series is to receive answers to questions that people have been asking since nearly the beginning of time. Let's find out the big picture perspective of who we are, why we are here, and where we are going.

name: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
summary: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist unearths the human truths behind some of the most extraordinary cases in con artistry.

name: See You Again
summary: The story of how a movie star from the Republican period Xiang Qin Yu unexpectedly meets a 21st century rookie screenwriter Jin Ayin and how they transcend the constraints of time and space to fall in love.

name: House of the Dragon: The House That Dragons Built
summary: HBO takes viewers behind the scenes of House of the Dragon. Each episode showcases everything from set construction and digital effects to cast interviews and producer insight.

name: A Beginner's Guide to Grief
summary: A once hot-mess, now just a mess, Harriet is about to learn that grief gives zero f*cks about playing by any rules and soon, neither will she.

name: Run BTS!
summary: A South Korean show by the boy group BTS. The show is all about BTS doing activities, challenges and lots more.

name: Drive!
summary: Drive! is taking you behind the wheel with some of your favorite celebrities and sports stars. Hosted by former basketball player and entrepreneur Austin J. Mills, each episode will be a joy ride inside some insanely expensive and tricked-out vehicles. In addition to showing off their hot rods, each star will open up about life, their careers and more during candid interviews with Austin.

name: Things That Make Me Groove
summary: Na Young Suk PD's ongoing 'New Journey To The West' mini series will be bringing viewers a brand new concept starting on October 23, centered around cast member Super Junior's Kyuhyun! Now, starting on October 23, Super Junior's Kyuhyun will be greeting viewers every Friday nights for 5 minutes through his alter ego, "Drunkard Jo"! It's currently unclear exactly what format "Drunkard Jo"s new mini series will take on, but Na Young Suk PD assured by the end of the teaser above that it will not involve Kyuhyun getting drunk every week, for the most part.

name: ТикТок Талант
summary: The world's first TikTok talent show, from song and dance to painting and poetry reading. The participants passed the all-Russian casting, and the best of them will perform on the big stage in front of the jury - Larisa Guzeeva, Dima Bilan and star tiktokers. The winner of the show will receive the title of the main talent of the country and 1,000,000 rubles, and the audience will choose it by voting.
